findings.finding: Decimal parameters are not canonically portable as raw JSON floating-point values.
findings.required_change: Represent all bounded ratios as scaled integers and freeze canonical JSON and CONFIG_ID construction.

findings.finding: Bootstrap, warm-up, recurrence precision and behavior after a proven gap are underspecified.
findings.required_change: Freeze zero bootstrap, a convergence-derived warm-up, strict IEEE-754 semantics and two explicitly tagged gap policies.

findings.finding: PUBLIC_RATIO_ATAN does not bind zero-denominator, quadrant or radian/degree semantics.
findings.required_change: Define a literal-source branch and a separate Ehlers atan2-degree descendant with no aliasing.

findings.finding: Fresh-cross equality, confirmation timing, quantile windows and same-bar re-entry are not explicit.
findings.required_change: Freeze strict cross ties, prior-only nearest-rank quantiles, one event per cross regime and one entry per completed signal bar.

findings.finding: Family names alone do not define a finite universe or maximum interaction depth.
findings.required_change: Enumerate every family variant, prohibit cross-family stacking at this genealogy depth and publish exact cardinality.

findings.finding: Signal, management, execution and stress identities are not independently defined.
findings.required_change: Create separate ID namespaces and a conditional trial-expansion rule.

findings.finding: Named-session and day-of-week mutations would be invalid while broker timezone/DST remains unproven.
findings.required_change: Freeze ALL-session only and exclude clock-sensitive families with UNIT_OR_CLOCK_UNRESOLVED.

findings.finding: No exact dual-enumerator parity, semantic alias treatment, test-count unit or all-passers rule is bound.
findings.required_change: Implement two independent enumerators, exact set parity, pre-result exact-mask dedupe and append-only trial accounting.
